Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ino...@ix.netcom.com wrote:
> Hi LSJ - Liking the new rulings, will begin to use them next week.

Glad to hear that. :-)

> If Wynn has a vial of Elder Vitae, and uses it to get a
> Rutor's Hand (for inf. thaum), does he get to keep the
> Rutor's after your next untap phase?

Yes. As with all minion cards, the discipline required to put
the card in play is only examined at the time it is played.
Increasing or decreasing (even removing) the discipline later
has no effect on the minion cards already in play.
